description: Image Description: The image depicts three giraffes walking on a grassy area. The giraffes have distinctive long necks and spotted patterns on their bodies, typical of their species. The two giraffes on the left are standing upright, while the one on the right appears to be lowering its head slightly, possibly grazing or observing something on the ground. In the background, there are trees with sparse leaves, suggesting a natural or zoo-like environment. The sky is overcast, indicating a cloudy day.
